title: Senior citizens can only be granted one type of discount, says SC

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines – The Supreme Court on Wednesday acquitted a hotel manager in Bacolod City of violating Senior Citizens Act, ruling that discounts accorded to elderly is not absolute as they could not be combined with other promos when availing goods and services. In Wednesday’s en banc session, the high court said that granting discounts or benefits on top of what is provided under Republic Act No. 7432, or the Senior Citizens Act, would “unfairly benefit the customer at the business’ expense.” READ: Solon urges colleagues to pass bill giving better benefits to seniors It stressed that the elderly, or individuals […]...
